sponsors.description:
Outbrain and Teads have merged to create an omnichannel outcomes platform for the open internet. The new company, operating under the name ‘Teads’, is embarking on a journey to elevate advertising outcomes.

The new Teads unites exceptional reach, an advanced omnichannel graph, data-driven creative, and predictive technology to drive meaningful outcomes from branding to performance.
It ensures value is driven by leveraging predictive AI technology to connect quality media, beautiful brand creative, and context-driven addressability and measurement.

One of the most scaled advertising platforms on the open internet, the new Teads is directly partnered with more than 10,000 publishers and 20,000 advertisers globally. For more information, visit https://thenewteads.com/.

sponsors.description:
Tenable is a global leader in Cyber Exposure Management, helping organizations proactively identify and prioritize critical vulnerabilities and risks across their entire attack surface – from IT and cloud to critical infrastructure. Tenable’s holistic platform reduces business risks, protects sensitive information and systems, and maintains business continuity and operational security.

We provide powerful, data-driven insights that allow security teams to act with precision and speed, comply with regulations, and protect their environments. Our platform, Tenable One, is evolving into a strategic tool for risk management and decision-makers in complex enterprise settings.

Tenable is publicly traded on Nasdaq (TENB) and employs over 1,800 people globally, including over 200 employees in Israel.
Our local R&D center in Tel Aviv plays a central role in shaping the company’s core technologies, while our culture fosters innovation, collaboration, and a shared drive to grow and excel continuously. Join the best people in the industry and build your future with us!

testimonials.testimonialDescription:
We solve complex challenges at scale, with room for innovation and bottom-up initiatives.
The culture is open and collaborative, with talented, driven people, and a strong balance between fast delivery and time for learning and growth.

Working at Tenable Israel is a unique experience - a place where top talent, cutting-edge technology, and a dynamic culture come together to stay ahead of the ever-evolving threat landscape. We tackle some of the toughest cybersecurity challenges, driving innovation and making a real impact.

The part of my role at Tenable that I enjoy most is brainstorming- discussing with others to find the best solution to a product challenge and learning from my teammates. We work on interesting problems, the work is very diverse, we have the freedom to choose what we want to focus on, and there's room for new initiatives.

sponsors.description:
Wix is the place for limitless creation and online success. Founded in 2006, our platform now serves 280M+ users across 190 countries worldwide.

We strive to stay ahead of the curve, always evolve, and provide efficient and innovative tools to help our users succeed at every stage of their journey. Wix is the all-in-one web creation platform with a full suite of tools to build, manage, and grow an online presence.

We even entered the AI game back in 2016 with the launch of Wix ADI, the first AI website builder that creates custom websites faster than we ever thought possible.

And the best part? We’re just getting started.

testimonials.testimonialDescription:
Engineering at Wix means working at real scale - millions of users, constant traffic, and big challenges. We’re using AI and modern tech to move faster, build smarter, and improve user experiences behind the scenes.

It’s the kind of work that keeps me curious and always learning.

Wix was the ideal place to transition from an engineer to an R&D team lead. It allows me to stay hands-on and technical while making a real product impact at scale.

At the same time, I'm growing as a leader by helping my team thrive - both individually and collectively - blending engineering excellence with meaningful team development.

At Wix, building resilient and scalable systems is not just a goal - it’s our reality. As tech lead for Backend Infra, I’m amazed at how we’ve architected an event-driven platform with over 4,000 microservices (and counting).

Every day brings new technical frontiers, and our collaborative culture empowers us to innovate at scale while keeping reliability front and center. Seeing our infrastructure fuel the creativity and growth of millions of users makes every challenge worthwhile.

sponsors.description:
Start.io is a sell-side omnichannel advertising platform powered by real-time mobile audiences. We deliver hundreds of millions of ads per day across thousands of global leading apps. Our platform uses AI to deliver more efficient, effective and precise digital advertising campaigns.

Our direct integration with thousands of mobile publishers gives us access to more than 50 billion first-party data signals per day across the globe. Marketers use these anonymized signals to understand and predict consumer behavior, identify new opportunities and fuel business growth.

Start.io was launched in 2010 by cofounders Gil Dudkiewicz and Ran Avidan, and today has offices in New York, Tel Aviv, Beijing, the U.K., Ukraine, Poland, and India.

StarkWare is a technology company building faster, cheaper, and more secure ways to run applications on blockchains. Founded in 2018, it uses advanced math and cryptography—called STARK proofs—to help systems handle more users and data without sacrificing security.
StarkWare’s main product is Starknet, a network that runs on top of Ethereum and makes it easier for developers to build scalable apps. The company is also working on bringing similar capabilities to Bitcoin, making it possible to build smart, efficient applications that use Bitcoin in new ways.

StarkWare is led by Prof. Eli Ben-Sasson, co-founder and CEO, a computer science professor from the Technion with past research roles at Princeton’s IAS, Harvard, and MIT.

testimonials.testimonialDescription: StarkWare is a rare mix of super-intelligent people who love solving problems and working together. It's fun, interesting, and challenging to come here, meet people, and exchange ideas. There are no limits, and every good idea gets a chance.

I’m passionate about exploring and understanding algorithms, and I’m equally dedicated to supporting the team around me. With a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and Mathematics from the Technion and a Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, and Cryptography from the Weizmann Institute, I aspired throughout my studies to be part of a cognitively challenging work environment. Luckily, the nature of the work here is exactly that.

I hold a Bachelor's degree in Mathematics and Psychology from the Hebrew University and a Master's degree in Computer Science from Tel Aviv University. Today, as a development group lead, my responsibilities range from guiding the team both professionally and personally to managing projects across various teams. The work is quite diverse, encompassing system engineering, working on a production system that must handle high loads, and mathematical research on the next algorithm.
Seeing the company grow from the very beginning – all the product changes, how people develop, and the relationships within the team – that creates real commitment. Plus, I really feel like I have an impact here. I have the power to drive things forward.

sponsors.description:
Plus500 is a world-leading online trading platform for millions of users worldwide, trading ~3bn$ per year across 50+ countries, placing millions of trades a month.

The next generation of investors is younger and more diverse than ever before, and finance is becoming part of their culture, participating in the trading markets, which is one of the greatest wealth creators of the last century.

It is our mission to disrupt the trade markets by building digital technologies that make trading around the world accessible and more efficient for all.

We are at a super growth stage, building new products alongside pushing the edges of existing ones, and are hiring talented R&D engineers and leaders across multiple disciplines and roles.

If you are passionate about crafting beautiful things at the internet scale, check out our careers page. We'll be happy to challenge you to your limits and shape the world of trading together.

testimonials.testimonialDescription: At Plus500, you're surrounded by talented people who are always willing to share knowledge and help you grow. It’s a place where complex engineering challenges meet constant learning, and where you're trusted to make a difference.

Plus500 gives me the chance to solve problems that actually matter, surrounded by engineers who push each other to do better work. The environment is supportive and collaborative, making it easy to learn and grow.

For me, working at Plus500 means learning something new every day, whether it's by tackling complex software problems or by collaborating with skilled colleagues, in a place that values both technical excellence and its people.

sponsors.description:
Workday is a leading provider of enterprise cloud applications for finance and human resources. Founded in 2005, Workday helps organizations manage critical business functions — such as payroll, talent management, financial planning, and workforce analytics — all through a single, cloud-based platform. Workday serves a wide range of customers, from mid-sized businesses to Fortune 500 companies, offering scalable and innovative solutions that support growth and drive success.

In 2024, Workday acquired HiredScore, a leading provider of AI-driven talent orchestration solutions. This acquisition enhanced Workday’s recruiting capabilities with advanced automation and insights to enable inclusive, efficient, and compliant hiring.

Workday’s office in Israel is the former HiredScore office, where we continue to develop cutting-edge AI-powered recruiting solutions as part of the global Workday team.

Cyera is the fastest-growing data security company in the $24 billion data security market. Its AI-powered platform gives organizations a complete view of where their data lives, how it’s used, and how to keep it safe, so they can reduce risk and unlock the full value of their data, wherever it is. Backed by top-tier investors including Accel, Coatue, and Sequoia, Cyera’s unified data security platform helps businesses discover, secure, and leverage their most valuable asset- data, and eliminate blind spots, cut alert noise, and protect sensitive information across the cloud, SaaS, databases, AI ecosystems, and on-premise environments. Recent innovations like Cyera’s Omni DLP extend this platform with adaptive, AI-native data loss protection, bringing real-time intelligence and contextual understanding to how data moves and is used across the enterprise.

testimonials.testimonialDescription: Knowing that I'm building a product that helps companies secure their most sensitive data gives my work real meaning. There’s a strong sense of purpose here, and it fuels both our pace and our pride in what we’re building.

Joining Cyera was a no-brainer. Exceptional talent, continuous innovation, and endless growth opportunities. Being part of a unicorn pioneering DSPM means constantly learning and stepping beyond comfort zones. It's exciting, rewarding, and genuinely inspiring.

sponsors.description:
Fullpath was founded in 2014 by three friends who came together to build a Customer Data Platform (CDP) and an AI-driven marketing automation platform (MAP) that now serve thousands of North American car dealerships, including some of the most savvy and forward leading auto-retailers in the United States.

Fullpath is driven by a passion for the impact that small, medium, and family-owned businesses have on local communities and economies. This has guided our mission since 2017 when our team wrote the company’s first piece of dealer-focused software. We’re still at it every day since and are gratefully learning from our customers and partners as we go.

is a leading B2B payments platform that helps small and medium-sized businesses in the U.S. manage their accounts payable and receivable with ease. By streamlining bill payments, invoicing, and cash flow management, Melio empowers businesses to pay and get paid faster — all from a simple, centralized dashboard. The platform integrates seamlessly with accounting software like QuickBooks and Xero and supports multiple payment methods including ACH, cards, and checks.
in June, Melio agreed to be acquired by Xero, a global small business platform. By combining Xero’s powerful cloud accounting platform with Melio’s bill payments platform, Melio is unlocking even more value for businesses, advisors who support them, and partners. With offices in New York and Tel Aviv, Melio continues to drive innovation at the intersection of fintech and operational simplicity.

testimonials.testimonialDescription: Working at Melio for the past 4 years, building multiple products from the ground up, and making a big impact has been a fulfilling experience. Melio has enabled me to grow in ways that no other company has. Seeing the engineering group grow from 20 to over 200 was a unique and challenging opportunity. I have felt valued and supported at every step of my journey at Melio, and I believe this has significantly impacted my personal and professional growth.

sponsors.description:
HiBob’s mission is to transform the world of work through Bob, its intuitive, centralized HR platform. Designed for today’s dynamic organizations, Bob simplifies complex global HR processes with automation, flexibility, and real-time people analytics.

Whether teams work in-office, remotely, or globally, Bob keeps them connected and productive. With customizable workflows, task automation, and advanced reporting, it empowers HR teams to streamline operations, enhance decision-making, and create meaningful employee experiences. Bob also supports localized experiences—languages, currencies, holiday calendars, and compliance—without needing professional services.

With over 5,000 customers and 1 million users worldwide, Bob is recognized as a leading HR platform that helps companies build culture, manage complexity, and drive business success.

Titan is the leading no-code platform for Salesforce, and we’re growing fast. With thousands of global customers and a product that delivers real value, we’re solving real-world challenges at scale using the latest in AI, Agentforce, and automation. Our platform helps companies in every industry build dynamic digital experiences directly in Salesforce without writing a single line of code.

From document generation to e-signatures, surveys to portals, and web apps to single-page applications, Titan empowers teams to design, launch, and manage any business interaction - internally or externally - directly on Salesforce. Everything stays real-time, secure, and fully compliant.

Our R&D team has grown exponentially in the past two years, and this is set to continue in the years ahead. We work with technologies like React, Node.js, JavaScript, Redis, AWS and more - plus our own internal frameworks for no-code builder logic, scalable workflows, and Agentforce-compatible AI. Every engineer here has a seat at the table, a real impact on the product, and an exciting growth path. It’s fast-paced, collaborative, and never boring.

testimonials.testimonialDescription: When I joined Titan, I quickly saw how supportive and collaborative the team is. There is always someone ready to help or share ideas, and every day feels rewarding to solve real challenges and see your work make it into production.

״Titan is full of smart, grounded people who care about building something that helps customers. I get to shape how we work, simplify complex problems, and contribute to a product that makes a difference.

As a full-stack developer at Titan, I work across UX and performance, always looking for ways to improve the product. It’s a place where learning, sharing ideas, and growing together is just part of how we work

sponsors.description: WSC Sports, the pioneer in AI-powered sports content technology, empowers their clients worldwide to connect with their fans through AI-tailored sports content experiences. WSC Sports’ platform automates the creation, management, and distribution of content, enabling sports rights holders to expand reach, grow fan bases, and unlock revenue opportunities across digital platforms.

Lightricks, an AI-first company, is revolutionizing how visual content is created. With a mission to bridge the gap between imagination and creation, Lightricks is dedicated to bringing cutting-edge technology to the creative and business spaces.

Our AI photo and video generation models, such as LTXV, power our apps and platforms including Facetune, Photoleap, Videoleap, and LTX Studio, allow creators and brands to leverage the latest research breakthroughs, offering endless control over their creative potential. Our influencer marketing platform, Popular Pays, provides creators the ability to monetize their work and offers brands opportunities to scale their content through tailored creator partnerships.

Founded in 2013, Lightricks is backed by prominent investors including Goldman Sachs Growth Equity, Insight Partners, Viola Ventures, ClalTech, Greycroft, Hanaco Venture Capital, Altshuler Shaham Investment Holdings, Harel-Hertz Investment, Qumra Capital House, Migdal Insurance and Financial Holdings, Shavit Capital, and Stonebridge Partners who share our enduring commitment to driving the future of content creation.

Elementor is the ultimate platform for web creators.
It’s a multi-product platform used by millions around the world, built by exceptional people who combine open-source thinking and real passion to shape the future of web creation.

We’re real people (AI-empowered, human-led) building a real product that gives real value to web creators.

Our vision is to empower web creators - developers, designers, and marketers- with the ability to create their futures one pixel at a time. We provide our users with everything they need to become successful.

Since we launched in Israel in 2016, we have expanded to more than 160 countries, with more than 18M websites powered by Elementor. More than 12.5% of all websites around the world are built using Elementor!

Mobileye (Nasdaq: MBLY) leads the mobility revolution with its autonomous driving and driver-assistance technologies, harnessing world-renowned expertise in computer vision, artificial intelligence, mapping, and data analysis. Since its founding in 1999, Mobileye has pioneered such groundbreaking technologies as REM™ crowdsourced mapping, True Redundancy™ sensing, and Responsibility Sensitive Safety (RSS). These technologies are driving the ADAS and AV fields towards the future of mobility – enabling self-driving vehicles and mobility solutions, powering industry-leading advanced driver-assistance systems and delivering valuable intelligence to optimize mobility infrastructure. To date, more than 180 million vehicles worldwide have been built with Mobileye technology inside. In 2022 Mobileye listed as an independent company separate from Intel (Nasdaq: INTC), which retains majority ownership

testimonials.testimonialDescription: Mobileye has powerful collective drive to succeed. As a software engineer, I work simultaneously with various components, ensure seamless functionality, and deliver the most accurate results.
We work with the leading automotive brands from around the world, as we adhere to the highest industry standards. Since I joined the company, my skills have only grown.

Mobileye’s culture fosters creativity and innovation. At Mobileye, I develop advanced algorithms to produce real-time, high-quality 3D pedestrian modeling based on various sources. This work is crucial for enhancing safety and improving the overall driving experience by preventing unnecessary braking and ensuring smooth navigation.

sponsors.description:
HoneyBook is the leading AI-powered business management platform for service-based business owners. Designed to enhance—not replace—independent professionals, HoneyBook’s AI-powered tools help businesses attract leads, connect with clients, book projects, and manage payments more efficiently. With AI seamlessly integrated into every workflow, entrepreneurs can focus on their craft while scaling their businesses with confidence. Since its founding in 2013, HoneyBook has powered over 25 million client relationships and processed more than $12 billion in transactions, helping independent businesses grow faster and smarter.

Our culture is built on five core values that inform everything we do. We encourage collaboration, feedback, ownership, and have a growth mindset. We know experience comes in many forms, some visible on your resume, others not. No one candidate will be a 100% perfect match to our description, so if you thrive in a fast-paced, intellectually-charged environment and have similar experience to what we are looking for, we encourage you to apply.

AI21 is a pioneer in Foundation Models and AI Systems designed for enterprises. AI21's mission is to create trustworthy artificial intelligence that powers humanity towards superproductivity. Founded in 2017 by AI visionaries Prof. Amnon Shashua, Prof. Yoav Shoham, and Ori Goshen, AI21 has secured $336 million in funding from industry leaders, including NVIDIA, Google, and Intel, reinforcing its commitment to advancing AI innovation.

Intuit is a global AI-powered FinTech company, proudly serve 100 millions customers. Our platform helps consumers and small business manage their finance and run their business efficiently, driving success and prosperity.

Our site in Israel is the 2nd largest R&D; center outside the U.S., employing 500+ engineers, developers, architects, data scientists, program and product manager and other technologists, specializing in the domains of Fintech, GenAI, cybersecurity, fraud prevention, and data exchange.

testimonials.testimonialDescription: The collaborative environment empowers me to utilize my data analysis skills for strategic decision-making, impacting our products and fulfilling my career aspirations.

monday.com is a global software company that transforms how businesses run. From monday work management and monday CRM to monday dev and monday service, our products are built on our powerful platform that can adapt to the needs of diverse industries and use cases. Our ~245,000 customers are reimagining how work gets done, driving greater efficiency, and scaling like never before.

The monday.com engineering org is a place where everyone is a driver, owns their domain, and leads initiatives that shape the future of work. We are deeply connected to our customers, bringing an impact-first mindset to every project. Our powerful platform enables us to ship new products at record speed, constantly pushing the boundaries of innovation. We nurture a data-driven environment, supported by cutting-edge internal tools, and a culture of engineering excellence. Our people get to work with the best engineers in the industry, tackle the most interesting tech challenges that lead to the most innovative solutions, and seize exciting opportunities as we rapidly scale.

Riverside.fm is a leading platform specializing in audio and video recording and editing for podcasters, content creators, and media professionals. The company's AI driven technology allows users to record and edit high-quality video and share it easily with the world, and significantly enhances the production quality of remote interviews, podcasts, and other multimedia projects.

Founded with the goal of simplifying the recording process while maintaining professional standards, Riverside.fm offers features like AI Based editing, sound and image improvements, live streaming, and easy file management. Its user-friendly interface and reliable performance have made it a popular choice among creators who need a seamless solution for remote recording without compromising on audio clarity or video quality.

With over 300 employees worldwide and over 170 employees in Tel Aviv, Riverside.fm continues to evolve by integrating new features and expanding its capabilities, aiming to become the preferred platform for remote content production worldwide. The company's commitment to innovation and quality has positioned it as a market leader in the rapidly growing digital media landscape.
